trial.q: How does the free trial work?
trial.a: You get 30 full days to use Belle Nails at no cost. No card required to start, and you can cancel anytime during the trial.

install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: No. Belle Nails works directly in your phone or computer's browser. You can also add it to your home screen as an app.

clientAccount.q: Do my clients need to create an account?
clientAccount.a: No. They book through your public page by providing just their name, contact info and desired service.

changePlan.a: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time — the price is adjusted proportionally.

billing.a: Payments are processed by Paddle.com as Merchant of Record, with all legal guarantees and refunds within 30 days.
